title: THE FPS PLATE SAYS WHERE A 60 HZ BROWSER COMES FROM
why: His order 10-28 with a picture of frame cap 144 and the plate reading 60 fps and screen 60: i have the game on 144 frame cap but its effectively capping at 60, can we fix this. The game draws only when the browser hands it a frame and the cap only skips frames, so 60 from the browser holds it at 60. The plate said screen 60 but not where to change it.
now: With the fps plate on and a cap above what the browser gives, a small line under the plate says browser gives 60 hz and names windows refresh rate, main display and hardware acceleration; it stays off in live raid play and when the page has seen faster frames.
